declared_assumptions: Integer arithmetic in Python is arbitrary precision and will not overflow for values up to 2^31.
The LCG state updates deterministically without hidden floating point conversions.
data.discriminating_purpose: Compute the exact face counts for the specified LCG over 10000 draws to determine if any count falls outside the 2-sigma fairness window, while providing a 10-step calibration trace to verify the recurrence and mapping.
data.hypothesis: The LCG produces an unfair distribution where count_6 equals 1724, exceeding the upper 2-sigma tolerance of 1719.
interpretation_conditions: The observable 'calibration' must exactly match the first 10 (X_n, die_n) pairs computed by hand from the specification.
If any count observable is missing, the simulation fails.
The fairness verdict is not an observable; it is a conclusion drawn from comparing the count observables to the tolerance window [1613.93, 1719.40].
rival_predictions: The generator is fair and all counts fall within [1614, 1720].
